info.name: FIWDEE - Master API Collection (All 5 Roles / Persons 1-5)
info.description:
Complete Postman Master Collection for CP353002-69 Principles of Software Design course project (FIWDEE Massage Management & Booking System).
Covers Person 1 (Dev 1 Auth & Users), Person 2 (Dev 2 Catalog & Master Data), Person 3 (Dev 3 Booking Engine & State Pattern), Person 4 (Dev 4 Queue, Execution & Observer Pattern), and Person 5 (Dev 5 Payment Strategy, Refunds & Reports).

item.name: Person 4 (Dev 4) - Front-Desk Queue, Service Execution & Observer Pattern
item.description: UC-12/13/14 (Front Desk Arrival & Queue), UC-15/16/17 (Therapist Service Lifecycle), UC-18 (Customer Review), GoF Observer Pattern Event Notifications

request.description: Customer arrives at shop. Front desk marks check-in, firing BookingStatusChangedEvent to auto-generate QueueItem ticket via Observer.
Receptionist queue display showing waiting, called, and in-service customers.

item.name: 4.3 Front Desk - Call Next Queue Customer (Staff)

request.description: Pops and announces the next waiting customer ticket in the daily queue.
Manually update queue status: WAITING, CALLED, IN_SERVICE, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
Therapist views their assigned massage appointments and queue status for the day.
Therapist begins massage session. Transitions booking to IN_SERVICE and room status to OCCUPIED.
Therapist marks massage session as finished. Transitions booking to COMPLETED and room to CLEANING.

request.description: Customer submits 1-5 star ratings and feedback for a COMPLETED booking.
